headline: Ikigai Finder, from entry to detail
overview:
The Ikigai Finder helps you discover your 'reason for being' by exploring the intersection of four fundamental questions: What you love, what you're good at, what the world needs, and what you can be paid for. Based on the Japanese concept of Ikigai (生き甲斐), this interactive tool walks you through each dimension with thoughtful prompts, then generates a beautiful Venn diagram showing your overlaps — Passion, Mission, Vocation, and Profession — with your Ikigai at the center.

After completing the assessment, AI-powered insights analyze your unique combination to reveal hidden connections, identify gaps, and suggest concrete next steps. You also get personalized suggestions for items to add to each circle, plus a reflection prompt to deepen your understanding.
targetAudience: Anyone seeking clarity on their life purpose, career direction, or sense of fulfillment. Whether you're a student exploring options, a professional considering a pivot, or someone feeling stuck — the Ikigai framework helps you see where your passions, skills, impact, and livelihood converge.

steps.title: Landing Page — Understanding Ikigai
steps.description:
Navigate to /career/ikigai to see the Ikigai introduction page. The page explains the Japanese concept of Ikigai (生き甲斐) — your 'reason for being' — and presents the four fundamental dimensions as colorful cards:

1. **What You LOVE** (pink) — Activities that energize you and make you lose track of time
2. **What You're GOOD AT** (blue) — Skills and strengths you've developed
3. **What the WORLD NEEDS** (green) — Problems and causes that move you to action
4. **What You Can Be PAID FOR** (orange) — Marketable skills and expertise

Tap "Find Your Ikigai" to begin the guided assessment.
steps.screenshotAlt: Ikigai landing page showing the four dimension cards (Love, Good At, World Needs, Paid For) in pink, blue, green, and orange, with Find Your Ikigai button

steps.title: Circle 1 — What You LOVE
steps.description:
The first of four circles asks you to reflect on what you love. A progress bar shows you're on step 1 of 4. The pink "What You LOVE" banner describes the dimension, and helpful prompts guide your thinking:

- When do you lose track of time?
- What topics can you talk about for hours?
- What did you love as a child?
- What activities energize rather than drain you?

Type your answers into the input field and tap the + button to add each item. You can add 1-10 items per circle. The input also supports AI suggestions and voice input via the icons next to the text field.
steps.screenshotAlt: What You LOVE circle showing pink banner, guiding questions, and input field with add button for entering items
steps.action: Advanced to the next state preserved by the app-owned walkthrough.

steps.title: Adding Items to a Circle
steps.description:
As you add items, they appear as removable tags below the input field. Each item has an X button to remove it if you change your mind. The "Next Circle" button becomes enabled once you've added at least one item.

For the best results, aim for 3-5 thoughtful items per circle. Don't overthink it — you can always edit your responses later from the results page.
steps.screenshotAlt: What You LOVE circle with three items added: Building software products, Mentoring and teaching, Exploring psychology and human behavior
steps.action: Advanced to the next state preserved by the app-owned walkthrough.

steps.title: Circle 4 — What You Can Be PAID FOR
steps.description:
After completing all four circles (Love, Good At, World Needs, Paid For), each with its own color-coded banner and unique guiding questions, you reach the final dimension. The progress bar is fully filled, showing 4 of 4.

The orange "What You Can Be PAID FOR" circle asks about marketable expertise:
- What would people pay to receive from you?
- Where is there market demand aligned with your skills?
- What economic models exist in your area of interest?

Once you've added items, tap "Complete Assessment" to generate your Ikigai.
steps.screenshotAlt: What You Can Be PAID FOR circle (4 of 4) with orange banner, guiding questions, and two items added: Software development and consulting, Product management and strategy
steps.action: Advanced to the next state preserved by the app-owned walkthrough.

steps.title: Achievement Unlocked!
steps.description:
Upon completing the assessment, you earn the "Ikigai Discovered" achievement — a silver-tier career milestone worth 25 points. The achievement popup appears with a celebration animation before revealing your results.

Tap "Awesome!" to dismiss and see your personalized Ikigai results.
steps.screenshotAlt: Achievement popup showing Ikigai Discovered badge with cherry blossom emoji, +25 points, silver tier, career category
steps.action: Advanced to the next state preserved by the app-owned walkthrough.

steps.title: Your Ikigai Visual Map
steps.description:
The results page opens with a stunning interactive Venn diagram — your personal Ikigai Visual Map. Four overlapping circles represent your dimensions, with labeled intersection zones:

- **Passion** (Love + Good At)
- **Mission** (Love + World Needs)
- **Vocation** (Good At + Paid For)
- **Profession** (World Needs + Paid For)
- **IKIGAI** at the center where all four meet

Clickable badges on each circle show your item count and let you edit that dimension. A "Download Image" button lets you save the diagram. The toolbar at the top offers Image, Share, Export (PRO), and Retake options.
steps.screenshotAlt: Interactive Ikigai Venn diagram with four colored circles (Love, Good At, World Needs, Paid For), labeled intersections (Passion, Mission, Vocation, Profession), and IKIGAI at the center
steps.action: Advanced to the next state preserved by the app-owned walkthrough.

steps.title: AI-Powered Insights
steps.description:
Below the Venn diagram, AI analyzes your unique combination and generates deep, personalized insights. The "What Your Ikigai Means" section includes:

- **The Big Picture** — An overall analysis of how your four circles connect (or where gaps exist)
- **Passion** (Love + Good At) — What your zone of genius looks like
- **Mission** (Love + World Needs) — How your passions align with impact
- **Vocation** (Good At + Paid For) — Your market positioning strengths
- **Profession** (World Needs + Paid For) — Where impact meets income
- **Focus Area** — A concrete, actionable recommendation

You can regenerate insights with the Regenerate button. Further down, AI-Powered Suggestions offer specific items to add to each circle, plus "Opportunities to Explore" with potential ikigai pathways. The page also includes a Hedgehog Concept section (from Jim Collins' Good to Great), next steps guidance, and a reflection prompt.

keyFeatures: Guided 4-step assessment exploring Love, Skills, World Needs, and Paid For dimensions
Beautiful interactive Venn diagram with labeled intersection zones
AI-powered deep analysis of your unique purpose journey
Personalized suggestions to strengthen each circle
Editable results — add or remove items and see the diagram update
Achievement system integration with milestone badges
Download, share, and export your Ikigai visual map
Hedgehog Concept framework for additional career clarity
Voice input and AI suggestions for adding items
tips: Don't overthink your answers — your first instincts are often the most authentic
Aim for 3-5 items per circle for the richest AI analysis
Revisit your Ikigai every 3-6 months as your priorities evolve
Use the AI suggestions to discover dimensions you hadn't considered
Click the item count badges on the Venn diagram to quickly edit any circle
The Ikigai is not a destination — it's a compass that evolves as you grow
Pair this with the Values Wheel and Personality Suite for a complete self-portrait
